newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Cetes rate sharply up on peso slump.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Cetes rate sharply up on peso slump.

text.p: Mexican overnight Cetes rates soared 375 basis points to close at session highs of 22 percent on Thursday.
Traders said rates had climbed on market jitters unleashed by a run on the peso.
"It's a fact that foreign investors are bailing out of Mexico and interest rates are responding to the peso," an analyst said.
Dealers added that uncertainty over the outcome of the U.S. government's process of rating Mexico's fight against drug-trafficking exacerbated market nerves.
